newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet to choose int'l partner by end-97 - MD.
newsitem.headline: Stet to choose int'l partner by end-97 - MD.

text.p: Italian Stet telecoms holding is seeking an international ally and will choose a partner "by the end of the year", managing director Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano said.
"This is our aim," he told reporters while attending an electronics conference. "The alliance will offer a service aimed primarily at business clientele."

Industry sources said Stet, which is due to be privatised by the end of the year, aimed for an alliance offering added-value services in the private telephony sector, the market sector favoured by all existing multinational alliances.
Stet already has a cooperation deal with U.S. computer giant IBM to market each others' products worldwide.

The joint venture, announced in December, some 16 months after proposals for a deal were first unveiled, was less substantial than many industry sources had expected and fell short of the wide-ranging relationship the market had forecast.
